title: Fiber ring laser biosensor based on no-core fibers for label-free DNA biomolecule measurements
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1831-1837
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08156K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lina Wang, Chong Li
The proposed biosensor can monitor the process of fiber surface functionalization and biological bonding. This layer-by-layer self-assembly method enables label-free measurement of cDNA at concentrations as low as 1 μM.
